skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and position of project financing in the curriculum. Understand basic issues related to project financing such as the concept, characteristics, and requirements of project financing.
Identify different forms of project financing and sources of funding. Understand the techniques and contract forms of project financing for different types of projects.
Evaluate and allocate risks in project financing. Develop plans for project financing.
Understand the financing methods and sources of various organizations and know how to exploit financing resources from these organizations.
Develop the ability to independently research, work in groups, and accumulate experience to continue higher education and adapt to globalization and the 4th Industrial Revolution.
Understand laws and comply with all school and class regulations.
Analyze the advantages and disadvantages of different forms of financing and traditional financing methods.
Prepare and present reports and slides, and engage in group discussions.
Work effectively in groups and present research findings.
Choose appropriate financing methods and organizations for real-world projects.
